job.prompt: Create a clean conceptual illustration for a SaaS marketing page showing the concept of 'Capture: Getting found by buyers on Google'. Show a stylized Google search results page with a B2B manufacturer product listing highlighted at the top position, surrounded by floating icons representing SEO elements: meta tags, sitemap symbol, structured data markup brackets, and a small upward-trending chart. A magnifying glass focuses on the top search result. Use a blue (#0d93e8) and white color palette with subtle teal accents on a light background. Flat modern SaaS illustration style, professional, minimal, not cartoonish. No real Google branding. 4:3 aspect ratio.
